## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] Read [`CONTRIBUTING`](https://github.com/thermal-label/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING/README.md)
- [ ] Code passes `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck`

- [ ] If touching public API: a `DECISIONS.md` entry or PR description note explains the why
